messages:
Iris: ran into a weird onboarding hiccup in the golang sample: after an auth 401 + retry the X-Request-Id changed and our logs showed an unredacted triple-backtick block with secrets. new customer was confused.
Tom: ouch. which go sdk version?
Iris: go-sdk v0.6.2 in the sampleapp. they use the built-in backoff which does a new request object per attempt.
Eve: sounds like ctx not being preserved across retries. backoff lib recreates request; need to copy request-id header or attach to context.Context and reuse.
Iris: agreed. sample logs: ```
INFO  client: starting request X-Request-Id=rq-33
DEBUG auth: refresh token
DEBUG client: retry attempt=1 X-Request-Id=rq-77
```
Iris: also payload had: ```
```
password: `s3cr3t`
api_key: `sk_live_abc`
```
and the triple-backtick block was printed unredacted after OTEL auto-init.
Hector: that's two problems: request-id propagation and redaction ordering with OTEL_AUTO_INIT. the autoinit path sets global log level to DEBUG when OTEL_EXPORTER_DEBUG=1 which lets early middleware log before our redactor is registered.
Tom: fix plan: (1) in retry wrapper, if ctx.Value(requestId) exists then set header X-Request-Id on each attempt, (2) add a logging.Filter/Hook that redacts messages in the logger itself as last-resort, (3) change OTEL auto-init to not mutate global levels by default (require REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_DEBUG=true).
Eve: also add a tiny unit test that simulates a 401 and asserts all emitted logs for that flow contain the same X-Request-Id and that redaction filter removes inline backticked secrets and triple-backtick blocks.
Iris: i've pushed a minimal repro to internal stash: https://stash.internal/sampleapp/go/telemetry/repro-2134 (private).
Hector: i'll open a PR to: copy request-id from ctx into retry, register the redaction log filter in go & ruby sdks, and update docs. assigning to @Tom for review.
Tom: will review this afternoon. can we also add an e2e in onboarding CI that toggles OTEL_AUTO_INIT=1 and OTEL_EXPORTER_DEBUG=1 to catch regressions?
Eve: yes add matrix row. also add a short onboarding note: "If you see unexpected DEBUG logs during setup, set OTEL_AUTO_INIT=0 or REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_DEBUG=0 until you finish onboarding."
ops-bot: created branch fix/keep-reqid-redact-filter and queued CI (unit + e2e-onboard).
devx-bot: opened ticket DX-1402 "preserve X-Request-Id through retries + logger-level/redaction ordering with otel-autoinit" and linked PR #612.
Iris: thanks all. small patch but high impact for onboarding. please mention in the release notes so support can point customers to it. :pray:
